app.title: RAG Evaluation
failure.provenance_unavailable: Canonical source location cannot be verified
metric.reason.provenanceUnavailable: The source text was returned, but its exact canonical location cannot be verified, so this metric is excluded from aggregation.

evidence.unavailableNote: Adapter capability is unavailable. This is not a zero score.

page.datasets.title: Datasets
page.datasets.description: Standard answers and source evidence remain outside every Worker sandbox. A changed byte produces a new dataset version.
page.systems.title: Systems
page.systems.description: Systems are registered by local CLI only. Credentials never cross into API responses.
page.systems.empty: Register a Worker system from the trusted local CLI.
page.experiments.title: Experiments
page.experiments.description: Read-only snapshots compiled by the native evaluation workflow.
page.experiments.readOnly: Create and run evaluations from New evaluation. Historical ExperimentSpecs remain visible here for audit and replay provenance.
page.runs.title: Runs
page.runs.description: Timeouts, crashes, empty answers, and unavailable capabilities remain visible.
page.runs.empty: No run records are available in this Platform home. Start the project with the bundled launcher to attach history.
page.runDetail.title: Run detail
page.runDetail.description: A durable view of one run artifact. It links directly to its existing case evidence without changing the artifact.
page.runDetail.notFound: Run {{id}} was not found in the current Platform home.
page.cases.title: Cases
page.cases.description: Follow evidence from native retrieval through ranking and the exact final context.
page.cases.select: Open cases from a run detail page.
page.cases.question: Question / Rep {{repetition}} / Seed {{seed}}
page.cases.answerJudgmentNote: This checks the generated answer against the Gold answer. It is independent of retrieval evidence coverage.
page.cases.evidenceUngrounded: Evidence does not support the answer
page.cases.evidenceUnverifiable: Canonical source location cannot be verified
page.cases.evidenceJudgmentNote: This checks whether retrieval and final context contain the Gold evidence. It does not change the answer result.
page.cases.evidenceDiagnosticsNote: These details help locate retrieval, ranking, or context-selection issues. They are not a second answer-correctness judgment.
page.cases.reason.rawEvidenceMissing: A required Gold evidence group did not occur in raw retrieval.
page.cases.reason.rankingLostEvidence: Raw retrieval contained required evidence, but ranking lost that group.
page.cases.reason.contextLostEvidence: Ranking retained required evidence, but final context lost that group.
page.cases.reason.answerNotGrounded: The generated answer is not deterministically supported by complete Gold evidence in final context.
page.cases.reason.answerDidNotMatch: Final context covered Gold evidence, but the generated answer did not satisfy the answer rule.
page.cases.reason.rawRetrievalUnavailabl: The system did not return observable raw retrieval.
page.cases.reason.rankedRetrievalUnavail: The system did not return observable ranked retrieval.
page.cases.reason.finalContextUnavailabl: The system did not return observable final context.
page.cases.goldEvidenceRule: all groups required · any item within group
page.cases.historicalMetricNote: This immutable run retains metrics from an older scorer. The answer result above was recomputed with the current deterministic rule without changing the original artifact.
page.cases.latencyNote: End-to-end query latency is Platform wall-clock from query dispatch through response validation. Native retrieval/generation timings, when present, are adapter diagnostics rather than cross-system speed claims.
page.compare.title: Compare runs
page.compare.description: Every metric declares its own coverage and comparability. Exploratory analysis never declares a winner; strict comparison requires a preregistered ComparisonSpec.
page.overview.title: Evaluation workspace
page.overview.description: A guided workspace for reproducible RAG evaluation. Research artifacts remain immutable.
page.overview.readyDescription: Choose a sealed dataset and a configured system to generate a canonical ExperimentSpec.
page.overview.setupDescription: Add a dataset and a standard RAG system before starting an evaluation.

error.platformAction: Keep the launcher running and open the WebUI URL printed by the launcher.
error.targetDiscoveryTitle: Question target discovery did not finish
error.targetDiscoveryAction: The document was analyzed, but the local model did not finish identifying usable source locations. Retry discovery; if it keeps failing, test Ollama in Model Configuration.
error.dockerAction: Start Docker Desktop or OrbStack, then test the connection again.
error.runtimeAction: Start the configured model service and confirm the selected model is available.
error.modelAction: Install or select an available model, then retry the connection test.
error.datasetTitle: The dataset Bundle could not be imported
error.datasetAction: Choose one valid Bundle ZIP with intact checksums and try again.
error.secretTitle: A required credential is not available
error.secretAction: Configure the credential in the local secure store, then retry.
error.timeoutAction: Check the RAG system and model runtime, then retry.
error.connectionTitle: The RAG system could not connect
error.connectionAction: Test the system again after checking its local runtime and adapter installation.
error.genericTitle: The operation could not be completed
error.genericAction: Review the technical details and correct the configuration before retrying.
